svg.title: Orbin shared Clover-layout reader preview
svg.desc: Screenshot-style illustration of Orbin 201 Huauzontle showing the Clover-layout Home reader, source selection, compact thread cells, and Orbin green branding. The embedded PNG is an unmodified 390 by 844 shared-UI fixture rendered by the Android host in iOS mode with local artwork; it is not a native iOS device screenshot.

g.text: The shared Android & iOS imageboard reader.
List and grid, explicit video, watch, save, and share.
Home, Boards, Watched, Search, Saved, and Settings.
4chan and BBWChan keep their complete source identity.
Roboto with app, site, and board preferences.
Read-only browsing · Local fixture artwork · No live user media in this preview
